message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:

    strategy:
      matrix:
        # configuration: [debug, release]
        configuration: [release]
        platform: [x64, x86, arm64]
      fail-fast: true

    env:
      SOLUTION_FILE_PATH: src/Shell.sln
      BUILD_CONFIGURATION: ${{matrix.configuration}}
      BUILD_PLATFORM: ${{matrix.platform}}
      BIN_PATH: D:\\a\\Shell\\Shell\\src\\bin
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Add MSBuild to PATH
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2

    - name: Restore NuGet packages
      working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
      run: nuget restore ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}

    - name: Build
      working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
      run: msbuild /m /p:Configuration=${{env.BUILD_CONFIGURATION}} /p:Platform=${{env.BUILD_PLATFORM}} ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: shell-${{matrix.platform}}
        path: |
          ${{env.BIN_PATH}}\*
          !${{env.BIN_PATH}}\*.lib
          !${{env.BIN_PATH}}\*.exp
          !${{env.BIN_PATH}}\*.wixpdb
          !${{env.BIN_PATH}}\ca.dll
        if-no-files-found: warn
        retention-days: 0
        compression-level: 6
        overwrite: false
        include-hidden-files: false
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs an independent 3-platform matrix (x64, x86, arm64) with fail-fast: false, so all platforms keep building even after one fails. Evidence pattern P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) reports scenario_passed outcomes for switching fail-fast from false to true, and the workflow has no verified required checks requiring every matrix outcome. Enabling fail-fast: true preserves build/test coverage for passing revisions while avoiding wasted work on the remaining independent platform jobs after a failure. No permissions, secrets, deployment, or new network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-FAIL-FAST", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242"]
}
